scoring_ceiling_analysis.summary: No function reached >=60 completeness score. Structural ceiling prevents it for all 10 functions.
root_causes: MSVC SEH frame variables (local_4, pvStack_c, puStack_8, puStack_48) — not renameable/typeable via API (-7.5 to -15 pts per function in undefined_variables_structural).
__thiscall ECX implicit this pointer — cannot be retyped via API; adds hungarian_violations_structural and type_quality_structural deductions.
this_00 ECX reprojection alias — same constraint as this pointer.
28-byte MSVC std::string inline stack buffers — would need create_struct() (W0 domain only).
Raw offset dereferences (+0x3c, +0xfc) — would need struct definitions (W0 domain only).
unaff_ESI / unaff_EBX register-only variables — not renameable.
Remaining unnamed local_* and uVar* generics after re-decompilation — Ghidra SSA variable proliferation after type changes creates new undefined locals.
scoring_ceiling_analysis.best_achievable_without_struct_creation: ~50 for thin wrappers (onTargetIDReceive); ~42-49 for medium workers (RegisterCallbacks, onBigWorldTimeComplete, onSquadList); ~23-31 for complex workers (ApplyTargetChange, PathDestroy, TickUpdate, onPositionUpdate); ~11 for heavily-optimized workers (RegionUpdate).

leash_gap.description: Server npc_ai_leash() snaps NPC to spawn instantly and does NOT send movementType=2 (Leash) CME event or waypath. Client never sees the leash animation.

combat_advance_gap.description: Server npc_movement_tick() sends AoI EntityMoved (position only) but not onRemoteEntityMove with movementType=1 (CombatAdvance) + computed waypath. Client gets no AI movement type hint.

key_findings.perfstats_telemetry: SGWBeing_TickUpdate (0x00dedf30) is the source of periodic client->server PerfStats CME events containing fpsAvg/Min/Max, bpsIn/Out, lagAvg/Min/Max, resends, AppearanceJobs. Server currently no-ops these.
key_findings.sgwsquadpath_struct: SGWBeing_onSquadList (0x00dec6d0) allocates a 0x28-byte object (SGWSquadPath); fields: +0x10c position handle, +0x1c follower count, +0x20 follower list tail. Pending W0 struct creation.
key_findings.target_event_wire: SGWBeing_ApplyTargetChange (0x00def320) emits a 12-byte NetworkEvent containing 'aTargetID' (uint). GameBeing+0xfc = current target entity ID field. Vtable +0x3c (slot 0xf) = entity validity check.

scorer_lessons_learned: Multi-line parameter descriptions (continuation line indented) cause 'Parameter count mismatch' — each parameter must be on a single line in the Parameters section.

Renaming a parameter (e.g., newTargetEntityId -> dwNewTargetEntityId) causes 'Undocumented parameter' if the plate comment still uses the old name — always update plate comment after parameter renames.
set_local_variable_type with type='pointer' leaves type as 'undefined *'; use 'void *' instead.

After set_local_variable_type, Ghidra re-decompiles and SSA variable names shift — call get_function_variables (or note error messages) to discover the current available variable set before the next rename_variables call.
Plate comment section headers must be exactly: Algorithm, Parameters, Returns, Side Effects, Magic Numbers — non-standard headers (CONTRACT, BEHAVIOR, KEY NOTE) are not recognized by the scorer.
